items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: We got Walter Page in there and ... Let me see, it was Lips Page, Walter Page, Buster Smith, Dan Miner

ctx.x: -- there's a good few years here.
I guess. But, anyway, I say, I knew where the good musicians are. Well, I'd say, get some of the Blue Devils, so that's how we got the Blue Devils. We got Walter Page in there and --

But, you know, I mean, we're talking really of probably 1922, and we've got -- let's see, you don't get with Benny Morton -- oh, Morton you get with in 1929. And -- well, do you remember anything about Gene Coin's band?

items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I got a picture out there, Lips Page, Lips Page, Count Basie, myself, Dan Miner and Bing Page and Susan.

ctx.x: Yeah. Page -- you've got Page, Willie Washington, drums, Basie, Leroy Barrie, guitar, Jack Weston and Eddie Baer, Ben Webster, Eddie Durham, Lips Page (inaudible).
Yeah, '29. I got a picture out there, on an album. I got a picture out there, Lips Page, Lips Page, Count Basie, myself, Dan Miner and Bing Page and Susan.
Well, now, this band, though, -- see, now, everybody talks about the records of 1932, with Morton Swing, Toby, New Orleans, Lafayette, --
